full_page.content:
Page 22 Cont.
Mar. 22 John Stankus - 30 - drinking - spending everything ... Mother and rest of family quite up set ....
Edward Vernier - 23 - abcesses of liver. Just married last year. He had strep-infection several weeks ago and now in such condi- tion that operation would be dangerous.
Mary Eliz. Fredericks - 72 - see March 9th - now has glandular trouble and stiff neck. Suffers patiently .... wonderful faith ...
25 Helen Nadean - 41 - of Monroe - severe pains in Eye. Also in head & neck. So far Drs have failed to find cause.
Page 23 Mar. 28 Edw'd Vernier - 22 - in Oxigen tent about a week - strep infection of liver, given till to-morrow to live; tapped this a.m. - perpet- ual enrollment started at 3:15 P.M.
28 Ella Gaunt - 59 - nerveous break - a cross to her charitable Family
28 Mrs. Rita Mason - 4 - bone cancer feared - Expecting first baby .... Enrolled 2nd time to-night perpetually
29 Richard Hayosh - 1 yr - fearful eczima and rickets .... Mother non C. ... since four month old. Enrolled
29 Phillip Ruggero - 49 - Epileptic - falls
31 Mary Dervits - 59 - "penticosals" - foot rotting and refuses to have Dr.
Therese White - 33 - Twelve years with headaches - lately unbearable Enrolled
Page 24 Mar. 31 Thomas Nail - 27 - Episcopelian - practically blind .... Friends fig- uering on procuring "seeing Eye dog" Enrolled To-night and advised to look into relationship between his denomination and mother Church ...
Edw'd Vernier - 23 - abcess of liver - Enrolled last Sat. when be- lieved to be dying ... hoped now that he may be spared.
Sedues in R
